title: Name the right part, ask for the rest
statement: When an answer is partly right, say which part is right and ask only for the missing part.
detail: A built Grade 3 lesson's feedback on a half-answer to a two-part question names the part the child gave and asks only for the missing one. A research-based conversation table for early reading makes the same move on a partly right answer: it confirms the part that is right, points to where to look, and asks what is missing.
